title: Privileged admin account without MFA
description: Privileged account can authenticate without an additional factor, increasing the risk of account compromise.
business_impact: Potential unauthorized administrative access to a synthetic critical application.
mitigation: Enforce MFA for privileged access or document an approved temporary safeguard.

title: Quarterly access review overdue
description: Scheduled user-access attestation has not been completed for the current review period.
business_impact: Access privileges may no longer reflect authorized business needs.
mitigation: Complete access review with application owners and preserve review evidence.

title: Legacy application lacks centralized sign-in logging
description: Application login events are not forwarded to the centralized monitoring system.
business_impact: Suspicious authentication activity might remain undetected.
mitigation: Enable supported log forwarding and validate alert coverage.

title: Critical patch pending on test gateway
description: A vendor security update has not yet been applied to a non-production gateway.
business_impact: Exposure may persist until the gateway is patched or isolated.
mitigation: Confirm compatibility, schedule maintenance, and verify patch installation.

title: Service account inventory incomplete
description: Some automated service accounts have no recorded ownership or review date.
business_impact: Orphaned privileged identities may remain active without oversight.
mitigation: Assign owners and update the service account inventory.

title: Backup restoration evidence missing
description: The latest quarterly backup restoration test lacks a signed evidence record.
business_impact: Recovery effectiveness cannot yet be demonstrated from available evidence.
mitigation: Retest restoration and archive approved evidence.

title: Expired test-environment security exception
description: An approved temporary security exception is past its review date.
business_impact: Unreviewed deviation from expected configuration may persist.
mitigation: Request renewed risk-owner review or close the exception after verification.

title: API key rotation control remediated
description: Previously stale integration keys have been rotated in the demonstration environment.
business_impact: Previous exposure has been reduced; closure evidence remains to be reviewed.
mitigation: Validate rotation audit trail and seek authorized closure approval.

title: Unusual sign-in burst investigated
description: An anomalous pattern of failed sign-ins was investigated and documented as test traffic.
business_impact: No residual impact recorded in the synthetic case.

title: AI experiment inventory awaiting owner confirmation
description: An AI proof-of-concept does not yet have a documented service owner in the internal inventory.
business_impact: Unclear ownership can delay review of data usage and operational controls.
mitigation: Confirm accountable owner, data handling and review checkpoints.

title: Privileged access review completed
description: Privileged users and their entitlements were reviewed and approved.
business_impact: No open impact recorded after documented review completion.
mitigation: Archive approval and access review evidence.

title: Data-feed change approval documentation missing
description: A scheduled non-production integration change has incomplete approval evidence.
business_impact: Unverified changes may interrupt testing and complicate traceability.
mitigation: Obtain documented change approval and record implementation controls.
